messages.subject: Understanding Multilevel SEM results
parts:
Hello,

I am new to lavaan and learning how to interpret multilevel SEM results from the lavaan website.

https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/multilevel.html

Regarding the level 1 results, do you know why all the intercepts are zero? Does this mean the model fits badly?

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Understanding Multilevel SEM results
parts: Notice that there are no standard errors estimated. These are fixed values, constrained to 0 probably by default, so that estimates of other model parameters will be statistically identified.
